description: Good decision: sieve_admin.rs splits the startup sequence into start_sieve_admin_server (sync, returns Err immediately) and run_admin_server (async, called only after the check passes). If the security check were inside the spawned task, a failure there would be a silent task-level panic with no signal to the caller. By returning Err synchronously, the caller can treat it as a fatal startup error and exit with a message, which is what the SMTP main does.
title: DECISION: sieve admin check is sync before async spawn
